job_description:
Aon's Reinsurance Solutions business is looking for an AI & Automation Development Lead!

As part of an industry-leading global broking platform, you will help deliver solutions on an enterprise scale starting from the art of the possible through production value realization and beyond. Solution types include data extraction from unstructured, and semi-structured documents, emails, and attachments, automated placements/ submissions/ claims, predictive analytics, summarization, comparison in expert systems.

Aon is in the business of better decisions.

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
What the day will look like

Lead multi-functional teams in the successful delivery of AI and automation initiatives using project management skills, agile methodologies, and software development standard processes. Inspire, enable, and effectively convey project team members, measuring performance and giving appropriate feedback.

Balance multiple vendors in various types including staff augmentation, fixed bid, managed outcome, etc.

Collaborate with product owners to define objectives, product scope, roadmap and measures of success and envision possibilities.

Develop strategies and formulate technical solutions for extracting data from documents and emails.

Design and implement persistent data storage suitable for transactional and analytical purposes.

Collaborate with enterprise teams on emerging technology, standard setting, and shared services.

Act as a go-to technical authority for topics in the AI and Automation space.

Build or coordinate artifacts that are required in the SLDC process. Participate in architectural design collaborations with architects and development leads.

Mentor development teams around practices.

Writes code as needed, particularly when its complex or difficult to achieve performance / scalability targets.

Works with quality lead on test strategy to validate business goals are met.

Be self-educating and self-motivating to stay at the forefront of technology while looking for opportunities to drive innovative business solutions. Educate and share knowledge with team members on new technology and tooling options.

• Overall 10+years of IT experience with minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI with a focus on document ingestion & data extraction.
• Experience with LLM, NLP, excellent systems, and machine learning techniques.
• Experience with architecting cloud native AI solutions.
• Proficiency with Python and SQL. Good grasp of relational and NoSQL database concepts
• Experience delivering AI solutions in an agile software development environment.
• Bachelor’s or master’s degree and/or equivalent experience in software engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or related technical field
• Experience with Azure services such as Cosmos DB, Databricks, AI Search, Cognitive Services, and Fabric are a plus.
• Experience with commercial AI SaaS document extraction products. (Ping Intel a plus)
• Experience building scalable and maintainable RPA solutions that integrate with enterprise services. (UiPath a plus)

In addition to our comprehensive benefits package, we encourage a diverse workforce. Plus, our agile, inclusive environment allows you to manage your wellbeing and work/life balance, ensuring you can be your best self at Aon.

job_title: Lead AI/ML Engineering – Infectious Disease
job_description:
Site Name: Seattle Sixth Ave

Posted Date: May 14 2024

At GSK we see a world in which advanced applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) will allow us to develop new medicines and vaccines with greater speed and efficacy. GSK is a unique company with world leading pharmaceutical and vaccines research and development organizations and a global health focus.

Infectious disease remains a constant unmet medical need, and due to the nature of pathogen resistance the need for resistance surveillance and rapid drug development remains constant.

The lead for AIML Infectious disease will be responsible for the development of models for emerging strain prediction and vaccine design, machine learning models for translational research and target discovery and clinical response. The lead will work directly with existing groups within the GSK AIML organization, particularly the sequence learning, cellular imaging and biomedical AI groups.

The lead will work on data generation and active learning for strain pathogenicity using a coupled lab in the loop, advise on data collection for surveillance on a global scale, and design standards. The group will produce models for next strain prediction and maintain the models derived from such data.

Working closely with the infectious disease research unit and other AIML functions the lead will provide support for AIML approaches for target discovery and integration of clinical data leading to models for pathogen sensitivity and response. The lead will also advise on the development of AIML aspects of diagnostic or decision support.

Competitive candidates will have a track record in developing state-of-the-art (SOTA) deep learning models for solving challenging real world scientific problems. You should be an outstanding scientist with in-depth knowledge in modern machine learning. You can convert biological/drug discovery challenges into well-defined machine learning problems. You can independently execute and deliver full AI/ML driven solutions from sourcing training data, design and implementing SOTA machine learning models, testing, benchmarking and product driven research for model performance improvement, to shipping stable, tested, performant code and services in an agile environment.

The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. Our leaders will be committed to your career and development from day one.

Description

About the Research
• The aim of this research is to develop theoretical and experimentational approaches for generalized AI model inference acceleration on resource constrained heterogeneous edge computing platforms. This research is also aimed at predicting optimal AI model architecture through neural network architecture search (NAS) to achieve expected inference acceleration. The research covers both convolutional neural networks and large language models for their inference acceleration.

This project covers the following research topics:
• Develop mathematical models to understand the trade-off between accuracy, latency, and compression of optimized AI models.
• Investigate state-of-the-art, quantization, model pruning and other AI model computational complexity reduction approaches for inference acceleration on edge computing platforms with resource constraints.
• Formulate mathematical theoretical foundations and mathematical models to guide the optimization process and ensure convergence to optimal solution while satisfying all the constraints.
• Develop layer-wise gradual optimization approaches.
